title: Act 2 - Chapter 3: Union Cave, Route 32 & Violet City (Zephyr Badge)
synopsis: Journey through the subterranean halls of Union Cave into the coastal winds of Route 32. Infiltrate the monastic stealth trial of Sprout Tower to claim the vital Golbat Boot, scout the western corridor of Route 36 and the National Park, and challenge Gym Leader Falkner in a 5 vs 5 duel for the Zephyr Badge.
